source.title: Derry Journal, 1 May 1933, p. 7 ("All unopposed in Derry rural district")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Derry Journal 1 May 1933 p7, read in the block image: 'All the candidates nominated were returned unopposed ... Other unopposed returns were:-'

note: Triennial election of the thirteen divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district, one member each. Nominations were received by A. W. Perry, J.P., returning officer; all the candidates nominated were returned unopposed, with two new members, in Ballymullan and Waterside (Derry Journal, 1 May 1933, p. 7). Filed on 1933-06-02, the Co. Londonderry polling day that year (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1933, p. 6). Returned unopposed.
